title: Countryman basis and club-isomorphisms under MA$(ω_1)$
summary: We show that unlike $\textsf{PFA}$, $\textsf{MA}_{ω_{1}}$ is consistent with the existence of $2^{ω_{1}}$-many Countryman lines which pairwise contain no uncountable isomorphic or reverse-isomorphic suborders. This clarifies an issue regarding the claim that $\textsf{MA}_{ω_{1}}$ implies that there is a finite basis for the Countryman lines. The family of Countryman lines comes from a family of $2^{ω_{1}}$-many coherent trees which pairwise contain no club-isomorphic subtrees.
